candidate: Green IT Aragón data-centre campus (SAMCA, Data Center Ribera Alta del Ebro SL), Luceni, Zaragoza, Spain
coordinate_reference_system: Source parcels in EPSG:25830 (ETRS89 / UTM 30N) as served by the Catastro INSPIRE cadastral-parcel WFS (GetParcel, srsname EPSG::25830; each response declares http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/25830); the planar area centroid of their union is transformed to EPSG:4326 longitude/latitude with pyproj 3.7.1 always_xy=True.
source_selection: Orden PEJ/536/2025 (BOA no. 98, 26 May 2025) declares the 'Green IT Aragón' plan of SAMCA and its subsidiaries Data Center Ribera Alta del Ebro SL and Molinos del Ebro SA an investment of autonomous and general interest. It places the campus of three data centres in Luceni, in the space bounded by the AP-68 and A-68, the Canal Imperial de Aragón and the road from Luceni to the La Loteta reservoir, and states that the promoters requested urgent occupation of the property affected by the location of the 'Campus de Datos', listed in annex II. Annex II has 16 rows: two land parcels, Luceni polygon 10 parcels 232 (152,530 m2) and 233 (118,508 m2), both owned by the Luceni town council, and 14 State-owned plots of 9-25 m2. Orden PEJ/1822/2025 (BOA no. 249, 26 December 2025) redelimits the overall plan area but leaves annex II unchanged. The BOA notice of 11 February 2026 for installation AT 2025/339 (SET Ribera Alta del Ebro 220/30 kV with seven 220/30 kV transformers, requested by 'Data Center Ribera del Ebro, SL' to supply the new data centre in Luceni) places that substation on parcel 50148A01000233. Both parcels were retrieved individually from the Catastro INSPIRE WFS (GetParcel). The 7,378 ha annex I polygon of PEJ/536/2025 also covers the wind farms and is not used, and the December 2025 coordinate list sits under www.aragon.es/documents/, which robots.txt disallows.
reverse_lookup: Catastro Consulta_RCCOOR at the WGS84 centroid returns 'Polígono 10 Parcela 232 PARIDERA DEL BARRANC. LUCENI (ZARAGOZA)' (50148A01000232).
precision: Planar area centroid of Luceni polygon 10 parcels 232 and 233 (27.10 ha in two parts 23 m apart, about 0.9 by 1.0 km), the land parcels that annex II of Orden PEJ/536/2025 lists for urgent occupation for the location of the Green IT Aragón data campus; parcel 233 also carries the campus's SET Ribera Alta del Ebro 220/30 kV substation. The point lies inside parcel 232. These parcels are part of the 68.3 ha campus sector, so the point locates campus land, not the sector centroid, a data-centre building, the substation itself or a surveyed boundary.
uncertainty_reason: Catastro publishes no positional accuracy for these boundaries; the two parcels cover 27 ha of a 68.3 ha campus sector whose boundary has not been published in a reachable machine-readable form, so the campus centre may lie several hundred metres from the point; the farthest vertex of the two parcels is about 600 m away.
not_located: The three data-centre buildings, the rest of the 682,929 m2 campus sector, SET Ribera Alta del Ebro (on parcel 233 but not positioned within it), the 220 kV supply lines, the Canal Imperial water intake, the A-68 accesses and the repowered wind farms.
distinctness_screen: Within 2 km of the new point: no record in sites.csv, projects.csv, source-records.json or identity-mapping.json of the current dataset, hundredtwentyfifth (the record being corrected is 3.7 km away), no point in any queue changes.json and no coordinate quoted in sources/*-holds.json; evidence.csv carries no coordinates. The nearest other Aragón site is more than 20 km away.
computation: uv run --no-project --with pyproj==3.7.1 --with shapely==2.1.1 python -I: parse each GetParcel exterior and interior ring, shapely unary_union, planar centroid, pyproj EPSG:25830 to EPSG:4326 always_xy=True, rounded to 7 decimals; geodesic area and farthest boundary vertex with pyproj Geod(WGS84); displacement by haversine (R = 6,371,008.8 m).
